name: Leonardo da Vinci
summary: Source of truth is the leonardo skill folder (stems, notes, tail, 15 anchor sheets, mode table in scripts/plate.py), read in place. For a sheet with no legible writing, flip=true turns right-handed hatching into his left-handed hatching.
public_summary: Drawings and notebook pages: anatomy, machines and flight, water and storms, horses, heads and caricatures, drapery, plants, landscapes, maps. Pen and brown ink, red chalk, metalpoint, tempera on linen, mirror-script notes.
